items.title: Ypsilanti zoning overhaul adds dedicated data center rules
items.dek: Planners will hold a public hearing on a new zoning division for data centers plus updated definitions and use charts that would apply across city districts.
items.source: City of Ypsilanti Planning Commission agenda
items.findings: New definitions added for Accessory Data Center, C-A Differential, Data Center, dB(A), dB(C), leq and Power Utilization Effectiveness (PUE) per the agenda packet | Permissible use charts amended in Parks, Single-Family Residential, Multiple Dwelling Residential, Production/Manufacturing/Distribution, Core Neighborhoods, Center, Corridors and Health and Human Services districts | New Article V, Division 4 establishes intent, accessory data center rules and principal data center rules covering application requirements, site design, operational standards, noise, water use, energy efficiency, landscaping, architectural design and decommissioning | Purpose stated as protecting public health, safety and welfare; promoting compatibility with surrounding uses; protecting infrastructure; and suppor
items.judge_note: Concrete new development: Ypsilanti scheduling a public hearing on specific zoning rules for data centers, a different municipality taking regulatory action.

items.title: Capitol watch: SB1047 — Senate Co-sponsor(s) Named: Jeremy Moss
items.dek: Public utilities: rates; separate rate class for large-load customers; require. Amends 1939 PA 3 (MCL 460.1 - 460.11) by adding sec. 10ii. Recorded action in the Michigan Legislature; see the full bill history at the source link.
items.judge_note: Concrete legislative development: Jeremy Moss added as co-sponsor to utility rate bill targeting data centers, a new action on a relevant bill.
